chunks: O believers, do not make friends with those who mock and make a sport of your faith, who were given the Book before you, and with unbelievers; and fear God if you truly believe;
ai.seo_question: Who are the believers instructed not to take as close friends or allies in this verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as a warning against political and social alliances with those who mock Islamic tenets, emphasizing that such relationships can dilute the community's spiritual integrity. The phrase 'from before you' highlights the historical precedence of the Jews and Christians, while the call to 'fear God' underscores that true faith requires active vigilance in social dealings. This establishes a principle of selective companionship (wilayah) crucial for maintaining doctrinal purity in diverse societies.
